tasks.outcome: The [System tab](/framework/ai/system/) now answers the owner's mobile ask: a page that explains the whole AI system.
Every major ask now gets a real card, written by code — the owner's dashboard explains why each score is what it is.

What landed: git-guard.mjs now refuses a recursive delete whose target is inside the main checkout, from any cwd, and any delete fed by git status / ls-files output run in main. Worktrees, the scratchpad, %TEMP% and /tmp stay open; deleting one file by its exact path stays open everywhere.
Landed. `/framework/` is a wall of sections, one per sidebar group, read from the sidebar's own tree. Classes get dark cards, columns balance by height, old page kept at /framework/old/.

All 5 unchecked JSONL writers closed. A hand Write/Edit onto an existing .jsonl is now blocked; the browser's rpc:append validates every line before writing; ledger.mjs's own writes go through one checked path that can never go silent; flags.jsonl has a real schema; new-task's day.jsonl route is named. Two fresh-eyes reviews caught a real bug — a static import that could have taken the whole ledger down — now fixed. Proof: 75/75 tests pass, confirmed again after landing. Applied to michael/dev, not committed (merge.mjs 3-way-merged onto edits already uncommitted there) — the owner still needs to commit the touched files. Every step and both reviews are logged below.
List now carries events itself — LiveList no longer exists. One class, [core/List/List.js](/framework/core/List/List.js): Events built in, the four verbs by id.

Section 5 harness check done, rung 0 + primer A/B built and mechanically proven; live cross-family model runs queued behind two real infra faults, not this task. Card: /framework/ai/2026/10/02/model-weights-rung-0-primer-a-b-section/. Findings: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/model-weights/harness-findings.md. Tests: /framework/ai/tests/rung0-html-to-view/ and rung0-html-to-view-primer/.
Reaped now, then guarded against it happening again.
